title: SMS Communicator Not Sending Response in Dev i but still works in Master (tried on multiple phones)
body:
SMS communicator is not sending a response (but will still implement commands). 

This problem first began when I switched from @tim2000s main dynamic ISF branch to his dev. I briefly switched back to master and it worked fine. I then switched to NS dev G, H and then I and its not working. I've tried on multiple phones (S9, Jelly 2, Atom and Not 10) and its not working on any of them. Master still works fine. 
--------------
- Time: 8:40pm I sent five different SMS commands
-AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1-dev-i
-BUILD: 671127673-2022.04.05-12:55
-logs and screenshots attached
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1649724181836.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8468679/AndroidAPS_LOG_1649724181836.log.zip)



![Screenshot_20220411-204217_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/73077567/162857620-15fce289-c84d-40a7-b156-d44b47836d6b.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220411-201853_Permission controller](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/73077567/162857624-053ddfee-9cdf-416c-ae21-bf1c0fd949d4.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220411-201440_Settings](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/73077567/162857627-0445ef86-8f5e-423d-9c82-724a31c33ec0.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220411-205048_Messages](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/73077567/162857633-b3d8e5ac-0819-4aaa-8874-523aab6e3bba.jpg)


Please let me know if there is anything I can do to help get you some useful data. 

Thank you, 

Coleby
